description: This file defines classes related to command objects used in a calculator or expression evaluation system, including parentheses, unary, binary, and operand commands, as well as a visitor interface for serialization.

classes.name: CParentheses
classes.description: Represents parentheses commands in expression evaluation, implementing IParenthesisCommand.

classes.name: CUnaryCommand
classes.description: Represents unary operation commands, implementing IUnaryCommand.

classes.name: CBinaryCommand
classes.description: Represents binary operation commands, implementing IBinaryCommand.

classes.name: COpndCommand
classes.description: Represents operand commands, including number values and formatting options, implementing IOpndCommand.

classes.name: ISerializeCommandVisitor
classes.description: Interface for visitor pattern to serialize command objects.

methods.name: GetCommand
methods.description: Returns the command code for parentheses.

methods.name: GetCommandType
methods.description: Returns the command type for parentheses.

methods.name: COpndCommand
methods.description: Constructor for operand command with initialization.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the operand value from a Rational object.

methods.name: AppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command to the list.

methods.name: ToggleSign
methods.description: Toggles the sign of the operand.

methods.name: IsNegative
methods.description: Checks if the operand is negative.

methods.name: IsSciFmt
methods.description: Checks if scientific notation is used.

methods.name: IsDecimalPresent
methods.description: Checks if decimal point is present.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Returns the token string with specified decimal symbol.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the operand with specified radix and precision.

methods.name: ISerializeCommandVisitor
methods.description: Interface for visitor pattern to serialize commands.
